objective: Compose an already-authenticated and already-normalized Telnyx voice event with provider-reference attempt lookup, deterministic reconciliation planning, recoverable execution, and one bounded stale-state re-read/re-plan cycle.
trustBoundary: This service accepts TelnyxVoiceEvent only after an upstream boundary has authenticated and normalized provider input.
This service does not verify signatures, parse raw webhook bodies, read HTTP headers, expose a route, or access provider secrets.
flow: Resolve the canonical attempt by provider telnyx plus event callControlId.
If no canonical attempt matches, return unmatched and perform no persistence mutation.
Plan reconciliation against the resolved canonical attempt.
If execution reports stale-attempt, re-read the attempt once using the same provider reference, re-plan from fresh state, and execute once more.
If the second execution is still stale, return retryable stale-attempt rather than looping indefinitely.
identityBoundary: Only callControlId matching the canonical attempt providerReference is supported in this slice.
call_session_id and call_leg_id are not promoted to canonical River identity.
Operator-leg versus lead-leg correlation is not invented here.
next: INS-002E2C or a dedicated bridge-correlation slice must resolve operator-first multi-leg provider correlation before public Telnyx webhook reconciliation is activated. Public webhook/signature work remains INS-002F and requires fresh authorization.
